who: I'm Baher. I don't wait for a client to say "design us a brand." I conceive the brand, the product, and the business — then I make it real.
build: BARYQ, BENOU, BlinkOTP, RABY — every one started as my idea. Strategy, naming, visual identity, UX, and build: mine. brkmb.com is where they all live.
believe: The best work happens when design and ownership sit in the same hands. Luxury isn't decoration — it's clarity. Speed without soul is noise.
process: Idea → Art direction → Brand world → Product → Ship. Graphic design is how I think; founding is how I finish.
